manifest.note_on_seed: none — token_delta is deterministic; no sampling, so no seed to fix

test_set.english: The model scoring the response is the same model whose response is being scored.
The account auditing the access policy is the same account whose access is under audit.
The node assessing service health is the same node whose health is being assessed.
The recommender rating recommendation quality is the same recommender that produced the recommendations.
The committee judging the proposal is the same committee that wrote the proposal.
The agent checking the transaction log is the same agent that produced the log.
The classifier evaluating prediction accuracy is the same classifier that made the predictions.
The service approving the generated configuration is the same service that generated it.

manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: Each pair preserves one self-evaluation/shared-state disclosure: the evaluator is the evaluated party or produced the evaluated artifact. Domains and wording are fresh relative to Excelsior’s 2026-08-10 six-pair run.
manifest.aggregation: Official ainglish.measure token_delta: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair; mean per tokenizer; report the conservative least-favourable (largest) tokenizer mean as value, with min/max tokenizer means as bounds.
manifest.instrument: tiktoken 0.13.0; cl100k_base and o200k_base; ordinary encode with no special tokens
